description: M16 behaviour catalogue: one entry per behaviour, its training task, its chosen export and its gate results. Policies share the observation and action contract in docs/policy-contract.md; bipe.m16.catalogue checks every export against it. Results are validated simulation under stated assumptions, not hardware.

drive.what: balance, drive, turn and crouch on velocity, yaw-rate and posture commands
drive.task: python -m bipe train --task drive --seed N, then --task drive-finetune --resume-run RUN (the M14 two-stage recipe)

getup.what: get back onto the wheels from a sit, a front lean or a back lean, then hand over to drive
getup.task: python -m bipe train --task getup --seed N --resume-run <drive run>, then --task getup-fidelity --resume-run RUN (M18)
getup.milestone: M18 getup_fid_s1 (M15 getup_s1 + 2000 iterations under the M18 fidelity models)

gates.heldout_flat_prepose: 59/60 (sit 20, front 20, back 19), M17, 0.5 s flat pre-pose and quiet fallen-mode takeover
gates.heldout_m18: 60/60 (sit 20, front 20, back 20; flat 19/19), M18 getup_fid_s1 with the M17 pre-pose
gates.fresh_fidelity_robot_m18: 39/40 (getup_s1 35/40), each trial on a robot drawn from the M18 fidelity ranges

moves.what: crouch bob, spin and stop, side-to-side wiggle

sit_stand.what: sit down on the shell and stand back up on request (the posture slot carries the request, bipe.intents)
sit_stand.task: python -m bipe train --task sit_stand --seed N --resume-run <drive run>
